blurb: Guests take a 20-minute boat tour on the Maid of the Mist to see the American Falls, Bridal Veil Falls, and Horseshoe Falls up close. Tickets include a free souvenir rain poncho and access to the observation deck overlooking the Niagara Gorge. Boats depart every 15 minutes during operating hours, boarding on a first-come, first-served basis.

extraNote: Tickets purchased online valid any open day during season · Tickets purchased at ticket booth valid only on day of purchase · Boarding is first-come, first-served for all passengers including online ticket holders · Boats depart every 15 minutes throughout the day · Boats operate rain or shine · No personal checks accepted; payment by cash, Visa, MasterCard, Discover, American Express · Tickets booths at street level in Niagara Falls State Park next to the observation tower. · April 24 through November 8, 2026
